body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said it detected seven People's Liberation Army warships, one official vessel and one PLA aircraft around Taiwan between 06:00 on November 8 and 06:00 on November 9, 2026. The single aircraft intruded into the northern airspace, according to the ministry's daily report carried by the Central News Agency (CNA). The ministry said the military monitored and responded using task force aircraft and vessels as well as shore-based missile systems.

The report covers the 24-hour window from 06:00 on November 8 to 06:00 on November 9 and gives no further detail: the CNA report does not specify the aircraft type, the vessel types, or the flight paths involved. The brief item was reported by 游凱翔 and edited by 蘇龍麒.
en.summary: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said it detected seven PLA warships, one official vessel and one PLA aircraft around Taiwan between 06:00 on November 8 and 06:00 on November 9, with the military monitoring and responding using task force aircraft, vessels and shore-based missile systems.
en.title: Taiwan tracks 7 PLA warships, 1 official vessel and 1 aircraft near northern airspace

body: 國防部9日上午公布共機艦動態，統計自8日上午6時起至9日上午6時止，偵獲7艘共艦、1艘公務船，以及1架共機侵擾北部空域。國防部強調，國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處。
這份動態涵蓋8日上午6時至9日上午6時的24小時；中央社報導未提及共機機型、共艦艦型或具體航跡，僅刊出國防部公布的數字與應處方式。本則報導由游凱翔採訪、蘇龍麒編輯。
